Metadata.title: La Moucherie — Handcrafted Flies from Québec
Metadata.description: Hand-tied fishing flies, tying materials, and tools. An independent Québec workshop for fly-fishing enthusiasts.

Home.heroTitle: Flies born on the water's edge
Home.heroSubtitle: Every fly is tied by hand, thread by thread, by people who fish the very rivers they imitate.
Home.featuredSubtitle: A hand-picked selection of patterns proven on Québec rivers and lakes.
Home.storyTitle: A new fly shop, an old passion
Home.storyBody: La Moucherie was born from a simple wish: flies tied with the same care you put into reading the drift. We're an independent, just-launched Québec business, and every order is prepared by hand in our workshop.
Home.valuesHandmadeBody: No mass production — every fly is checked before it ships.
Home.valuesLocalBody: Patterns designed for our rivers, our lakes, and our seasons.
Home.valuesQualityBody: We choose durable materials for flies that hold up on the line.
Home.newsletterBody: New patterns, material restocks, and tying tips — straight to your inbox.

About.title: Our Story
About.p1: La Moucherie started on a riverbank, in front of a fly box that was empty too often. We wanted a source of flies tied with the same respect for the craft found in the best tyers we know.
About.p2: We're an independent, freshly-launched business based in Québec. Every fly, kit, and pack of materials that leaves our workshop is prepared by hand, in small batches, with real attention to durability and on-the-water performance.
About.p3: Our goal is simple: whether you fish our flies or learn to tie your own with our materials and kits, they should feel like they were made by people who love the river as much as you do.
About.quote: A well-tied fly always starts with good materials — and a lot of patience.
